__NOTOC__{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|yield=12|time=35 minutes|difficulty=3|Image=}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]

An '''ice cream sandwich''' is a frozen dessert consisting of ice cream sandwiched between two cookie layers. They are typically circular or rectangular in shape, although other novelty shapes exist as well.
== Ingredients ==
*80 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (2.8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / ⅔ stick) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*125 g (4.4 oz / ⅝ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]
*1 standard [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*180 g (6.3 oz / 1¼ cups) plain [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]], plus extra for dusting
*20 g (0.71 oz / 1 heaped [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]]) [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|bicarbonate of soda]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*500 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (1.1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] / 2 cups) [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]]
== Procedure ==
#Mix the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda, and salt in a bowl.
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
#Beat in the egg.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients, and bring together until a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] forms.
#[[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the dough for 2 minutes on a floured surface until smooth.
#Shape the dough into a flat disc.
#Cover with [[Cookbook:Cling film|cling film]] and chill for 30 minutes.
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{Convert|190|C|F}}.
#Cover 2 [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking trays]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|baking paper]].
#[[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] the dough to {{Convert|5|mm|in|abbr=on}} thick.
#Cut out into 24 circles, and arrange on the baking trays.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 10–12 minutes until well-cooked.
#Place the biscuits on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]] and leave to cool.
#Scoop 1 scoop of ice cream on a biscuit.
#Sandwich together with another biscuit.
#Repeat steps 15–16, using remaining biscuits and ice cream.
#Enjoy!
==Notes, tips, and variations==
*If the dough is too wet, mix in 1 tablespoon of plain flour.
*Ice cream sandwiches can be frozen for up to 3 months.
*This recipe uses chocolate biscuits. For vanilla biscuits, replace cocoa powder with extra 20 g (0.71 oz / 1 heaped tablespoon) plain flour and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract. Add vanilla when beating butter and sugar.
